flipToBack.timing: Required singleton trigger on isTableChanged (standing state)
flipToBack.prose: Flips when Credits Will Do Fine is active on table and has 4 or more cards stacked beneath it. Pure counter-on-card check; no control/occupy/presence requirement.

children.req: card-on-table: Credits Will Do Fine active
count/counter: 4+ cards stacked on Credits Will Do Fine

flipToFront.timing: NEVER. Back has no flip trigger, no lose condition, and no place-out-of-play condition; the flip is one-way permanent.
flipToFront.prose: Card12_089_BACK contains no FlipCardEffect and no PlaceCardOutOfPlayFromTableEffect anywhere; getGameTextRequiredAfterTriggers only implements the end-of-control-phase senator Force-loss enforcement.

requirementSemantics: Flip is COUNT/COUNTER semantics: hasStackedCards(CreditsWillDoFine, 4). Cards get stacked on Credits Will Do Fine by that Effect's own game text; the objective only reads the count.
Requires Credits Will Do Fine to be ACTIVE (findFirstActive) - if the Effect is gone, the flip can never fire regardless of prior stacking.

Back's per-control-phase Force loss uses occupiesWith semantics: Filters.countTopLocationsOnTable(game, Filters.and(Filters.battleground_site, Filters.occupiesWith(playerId, self, Filters.senator))) - occupy WITH a senator, not control.
Back's opponent-control-phase activation is card-at-location: canSpot(Filters.and(Filters.Queens_Royal_Starship, Filters.at(Filters.planet_system))).
typedIdentities: Filters.Maul (immune to attrition - benefits opponent's Maul)
Filters.alien (may not have deploy cost modified)
setupAndPullRoutes: Start of game deploys Watto's Junkyard, City Outskirts, and Credits Will Do Fine from Reserve Deck (front:49-73).
Front tutor: once per game, take Coruscant system and/or Tatooine system into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle (TakeCardAndOrCardIntoHandFromReserveDeckEffect, front:93-112).
No pulls/tutors coded on the back.
otherObligations: Front, remainder of game: may not deploy cards with ability except unique aliens, Republic characters, Republic starships, and [Episode I] Jedi; may not deploy using Dejarik rules; Your Destiny suspended (front:76-90).
Front, while this side up: may not deploy any systems; opponent's Maul is immune to attrition (front:115-122).
Back: your unique Republic characters power +1 and forfeit +2; aliens may not have deploy cost modified; Imperials deploy +1 to Tatooine sites (BACK:54-63).
Back: whenever you draw battle destiny (destiny card not null), may retrieve 1 Force, may be taken into hand (BACK:66-92).
Back: while Queen's Royal Starship at a planet system, once during each of opponent's control phases may activate up to 2 Force (BACK:99-129).

Back: once during each of your control phases, opponent loses 1 Force per battleground site you occupy with a senator; auto-enforced at end of your control phase if not yet performed (BACK:131-148, 154-177).
